title: Communication in Relationships
aliases: partner er sathe kotha bolar niyom
summary: Good communication means expressing needs clearly, listening without interrupting and responding with respect. It's the foundation of nearly every healthy relationship skill.
key_points: Use 'I feel… when… I need…' statements.
Listen to understand, not just to reply.
Timing matters — calm moments work best.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
